# The Light Company

> Prism brings projected guidance and camera-based observation to physical work. The public website explains Prism Robotics and Prism IRL. The company has also used the name lght.co.

## Product and evidence

- [Prism Robotics](https://lightcompany.ai/prism-robotics): projected staging, camera-based scene checks and the workflow for connecting physical conditions to trials.
- [How it works](https://lightcompany.ai/prism-robotics/how-it-works): define, calibrate, stage, verify, run, review and revisit.
- [Technical brief](https://lightcompany.ai/media/prism-technical-brief.pdf): company-authored mechanism and limitations. Operational estimates are from limited partner context, not independent universal measurements.
- [Lab films](https://lightcompany.ai/gallery): recorded demonstrations, not proof of universal accuracy or compatibility.
- [Prism IRL](https://lightcompany.ai/prism): projected interfaces for everyday surfaces.

## Concepts and illustrative content

- [Scene history](https://lightcompany.ai/prism-robotics/scene-history): proposed “Git for your physical space” experience. The controls change a local diagram only. Scene branching, collaborative review and automated regression scheduling are product direction, not verified available services.
- [Benchmarks](https://lightcompany.ai/benchmarks): illustrative scores and sample trial records. Do not cite them as measured model performance, a winner or a vendor endorsement.

## Company and practical information

- [Prism Robotics: physical AI evaluation](https://lightcompany.ai/prism-robotics): Meet Prism: projected scene staging, camera-based verification and a record of physical conditions for more useful robot policy evaluation.
- [How Prism works: from scene to evidence](https://lightcompany.ai/prism-robotics/how-it-works): Follow a physical robot evaluation through calibration, projected staging, scene verification, recording and review with Prism.
- [About The Light Company](https://lightcompany.ai/company): The Light Company builds Prism: light and vision for physical work, from robot evaluation to interfaces on the surfaces around us.
- [Careers and collaboration](https://lightcompany.ai/careers): Explore work at The Light Company across robotics, perception, optics, software and design. Share your work and interest in Prism.
- [Contact the Prism team](https://lightcompany.ai/contact): Contact The Light Company about a Prism workcell, research collaboration, investment, careers, support or a website question.
- [Robot evaluation guides and resources](https://lightcompany.ai/resources): Practical guides to robot policy evaluation, initial conditions, capability maps and physical scene history, plus Prism lab films and a technical brief.
- [How to plan a real-world robot evaluation](https://lightcompany.ai/resources/robot-evaluation): A practical guide to defining a robot task, preparing conditions, recording interventions and reporting results another team can understand.
- [Why robot evaluation starts with the reset](https://lightcompany.ai/resources/initial-conditions): Object placement, camera setup and scoring rules can change an evaluation. Learn how to separate intended conditions from what actually happened.
- [Capability maps for robot policies](https://lightcompany.ai/resources/capability-maps): Go beyond a single robot success rate. Organize evaluation by position, orientation, clutter, objects and lighting while preserving untested conditions.
- [Git for physical space: what should a scene remember?](https://lightcompany.ai/resources/physical-version-control): An essay on physical version control: scene identity, revision history, evidence and the limits of replay in a changing world.
- [Website terms of service](https://lightcompany.ai/terms): Terms for using The Light Company's public website, including content, concept demonstrations, interest forms and third-party links.
- [Privacy notice](https://lightcompany.ai/privacy): How The Light Company's public website handles inquiry information, station interest forms, technical service data and third-party media.
- [Cookies and browser storage](https://lightcompany.ai/cookies): Learn about session storage, third-party media and service cookies on The Light Company's website, and the choices available in your browser.
- [Security, data and trust](https://lightcompany.ai/trust): Understand the public website's data boundaries, how to report a security concern and the questions to settle before a Prism deployment.
- [Accessibility and assistance](https://lightcompany.ai/accessibility): Accessibility information for The Light Company's website, including keyboard navigation, reduced motion and how to request help with content.
- [Investors](https://lightcompany.ai/robotics/investors): company thesis.
- [Station interest](https://lightcompany.ai/order): inquiry only; no payment, allocation or delivery promise.
- [Public agent guide](https://lightcompany.ai/agents.md): source interpretation and interaction boundaries.
